title.narrative: Support for the preparation of nomination dossiers for the Rusizi National Park/Lake Tanganyika ecosystem and Kibira National Park as a biosphere reserve and for possible inscription on the World Heritage List

description.narrative: The Rusizi National Park is located near Bujumbura and covers an area of around 10,700 ha. It offers a mosaic of rich ecosystems, ranging from marshes and lagoons to palm forests that are unique in the world, and flooded meadows that serve as nesting sites for migratory and sedentary birds. The park is classified as a Ramsar site (a wetland of international importance). To this end, a series of activities will be carried out, including training and strengthening national and local capacities, developing and/or updating biophysical, socioeconomic, and cultural data as well as management and conservation tools, Carrying out co-construction consultations with all the stakeholders.
